description: Who you are and how posterly is connected. view=identity (default): the authenticated user, API key scopes, workspaces, and onboarding next step. Pass include=api_keys to also list this account's API keys (name, prefix, scopes, created, last used). The secret is never included. Call this first. If onboarding.completed is false, run onboarding IN THIS conversation: ask what to call the user and their IANA timezone, save them with complete_onboarding, then offer create_connect_session; do not send the user to /onboarding-v2. If onboarding.completed is true, never ask the onboarding questions again. view=status: MCP server version, latest npm version, endpoint and API key health, and update guidance; works before POSTERLY_API_KEY is configured.

include.description: identity only. api_keys lists this account's API keys. The secret is never included. Omit it for the usual identity answer.
